summary: Mini town, big business! Fun, addicting & casual farming & shop management game!
description: MicroTown.io - My Little Town Build a business from the ground up! MicroTown.io merges the fun of farming & mini mart management games with idle upgrade progression – all wrapped up in sleek & smooth graphics! Be the boss of your town: gather goods, collect cash & upgrade your mini market. Hire employees & build your tiny town into a massive marketplace empire while idle & relaxing! Build & upgrade your shops, create custom pick-up orders & keep customers coming back for more. From organic farming harvests to tasty baked goods & sweet candy treats - and so much more - business is about to boom in MicroTown! = MicroTown.io Features = 🛒 Mini Mart Management Game 😊 • Build & manage your mini market • Farm organic goods & harvest crops • Sell goods to eager customers • Collect cash & build your business with bakeries & more! 🚜 Farming & Business Simulation 💵 • Build plots of land, areas for animals & processing stations • Customize your upgraded farms & shops however you want! • Idle io gameplay - hire employees to lend a helping hand • From wheat to treats, upgrade your mini mart to meet market demands! 🚚 Mini Mart, Mini Games 🕹️ • Customer tastes are always changing. Tap to keep up! • Custom orders coming in hot! Stock up on goods and be prepared. • Earn bonus cash from custom orders & keep business booming! • Grow your empire to the world map to discover new things to do! 📱 Play online or offline, no WIFI 📴 • No WIFI out on the farm? No problem! • Play without internet or play online. Your town, your rules! • Play online & compete on leaderboards! Whether you’re into relaxing with casual & idle gameplay or are addicted to the action of tap tap tapping to upgrade fast, you’re the boss - your MicroTown is managed your way. Download MicroTown.io now and build your mini market into a farming & shopping megacenter! Read/write storage permissions are used for MicroTown.io screenshots and cache user save files. Record audio permission is used for recording YouTube video for sharing. Your reviews are important for the MicroTown.io team, let us know what you think! Privacy: https://kooapps.com/privacypolicy.php
